title: Know Your Limits: A Survey of Abstention in Large Language Models
best_for_zh: 关注幻觉缓解、安全回答和选择性预测的读者。
one_line: A TACL 2025 survey organizing LLM abstention through the query, model, and human values.
从查询、模型和人类价值三个角度梳理大语言模型何时应当拒答。
why: It treats declining to answer as a decision that must be both useful and accountable to context.
inclusion_reason: A TACL survey that helps readers compare abstention methods with their evaluation and value assumptions visible.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Abstention means that an LLM declines to provide an answer. This TACL 2025 survey asks when that behavior can reduce hallucination and improve safety without making a system unhelpful, and it frames the question through the query, the model, and human values.

The decision boundary matters: abstention is neither an error by definition nor a universal remedy. A useful system needs to distinguish unsupported answers from questions it can answer responsibly, while recognizing that the cost of an incorrect answer and the cost of a refusal can differ by context. The survey asks readers to make those costs visible rather than treating every non-answer as equally safe.

拒答是指大语言模型选择不提供答案。TACL 2025 这篇综述讨论：这种行为何时能减少幻觉、提升安全性，同时又不让系统失去帮助性；它从查询、模型和人类价值三个角度提出问题。

这里的决策边界十分重要：拒答本身并不天然是错误，也不是万能补救。一个有用的系统应区分“没有依据的回答”和“可以负责任回答的问题”，同时承认不同情境中答错与拒答的代价并不相同。综述要求读者把这些代价说清楚，而不是把所有不回答都当成同样安全。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper's framework separates three things that are often mixed together: what the query demands, what the model can support, and what people value in the situation. It uses this framework to organize abstention methods, benchmarks, and evaluation metrics.

The framework is a reading tool as much as a taxonomy. Query properties can make an answer hard or underspecified; model properties determine what support is available; human values determine which error is more costly. Keeping the three perspectives separate prevents a confidence score or a refusal rate from being mistaken for a complete safety judgment. A method should be read with the perspective it actually addresses.

论文的框架分开看三件常被混淆的事：查询要求什么、模型能否支撑回答、情境中的人类价值是什么。它据此整理拒答方法、基准和评估指标。

这一框架既是分类方式，也是阅读工具。查询本身可能困难或信息不足；模型的性质决定可获得何种支撑；人类价值则决定哪类错误代价更高。把三者分开，能避免把一个置信度分数或拒答率误当成完整的安全判断。阅读方法时，应看它实际处理的是哪一个视角。

title: Method
方法
html:
As a survey, it synthesizes prior methods rather than training a new model. Its unit of analysis is an answer-or-abstain decision, and it groups literature on methods, benchmarks, and metrics using the query-model-values framework.

This means the paper does not prescribe one threshold or one output format. It gathers ways earlier work produces, evaluates, or governs an answer-or-abstain choice and places them beside the assumptions that choice depends on. When following a cited technique, recover from the primary source what information it uses, whether refusal is explicit, and how correct answers, unsupported answers, and unnecessary refusals are scored.

作为综述，论文整合已有方法，而不是训练新模型。它的分析单位是“回答还是拒答”的决策，并用查询—模型—价值框架归纳方法、基准和指标。

这意味着论文并未规定一个统一阈值或输出格式。它汇集已有研究如何产生、评测或约束“回答还是拒答”的选择，并把它们放回相应假设中理解。追读某项技术时，应从原文确认它使用什么信息、拒答是否明确表达，以及正确回答、无依据回答和不必要拒答如何计分。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The evidence is the survey's organization of prior methods, benchmarks, and metrics, not a new leaderboard. Its official abstract also identifies an open question: whether abstention can become a capability that transfers across tasks and domains.

That open question is a practical caution. An approach that looks well calibrated on one benchmark may depend on that benchmark's answer format, error distribution, or cost assumptions. The survey offers a way to inspect such evidence: record the task, what counts as an abstention, the comparison policy, and the metric. Only then can reported coverage or accuracy be interpreted as evidence for a broader deployment decision.

证据来自论文对已有方法、基准和指标的整理，而不是新的排行榜。官方摘要还提出一个开放问题：拒答能否成为一种跨任务、跨领域迁移的能力。

这一开放问题也是实际提醒：某种方法在一个基准上看似校准良好，可能依赖该基准的答案格式、错误分布或代价假设。综述提供了检查证据的方式：记录任务、何种输出算拒答、比较策略和指标。只有这样，覆盖率或准确率才能被解释为对更广泛使用决定的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Its distinctive contribution is to place human values beside query difficulty and model capability. That shift is useful because an identical refusal can be appropriate in one context and unnecessarily restrictive in another.

The contribution is not a claim that more refusal is always preferable. It explains why a behavior cannot be evaluated without stating who bears its consequences and what information is available. This is a useful corrective to comparisons based only on aggregate scores. It lets readers ask whether a proposed improvement changes the model's evidence, the decision policy, or merely the evaluation preference used to declare success.

它的突出贡献是把人类价值与查询难度、模型能力并列考虑。这一点很重要，因为同一种拒答在某个情境中可能恰当，在另一个情境中却可能过度保守。

它的贡献并不是宣称拒答越多越好，而是说明评价一种行为时必须交代谁承担后果、系统掌握什么信息。这能纠正只依赖汇总分数的比较方式，让读者追问所谓提升改变的是模型的证据、决策策略，还是仅仅改变了判定成功的评价偏好。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Different studies may reward coverage, factual correctness, safety, or user preference differently, so abstention scores require their metric definitions. The survey does not establish one universally correct refusal threshold.

The survey also cannot turn a value-sensitive choice into a context-free number. A refusal policy may be appropriate only for a particular user group, task, or consequence model. It summarizes a literature whose methods and benchmarks vary, rather than validating every policy in a common environment. Readers should therefore avoid transferring a threshold without checking the task, intended audience, and response options.

不同研究可能分别重视回答覆盖率、事实正确性、安全性或用户偏好，因此拒答分数必须结合指标定义理解。该综述没有给出一个放之四海皆准的拒答阈值。

综述也不能把与价值有关的选择化成脱离语境的数字。一项拒答策略可能只适合某个用户群、任务或后果模型。它整理的是方法和基准各不相同的文献，而不是在一个共同环境中验证所有策略。因此，不应在未检查任务、目标用户和可选回应前直接迁移阈值。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this paper when designing a system that should sometimes withhold an answer. It provides a checklist for asking whether a proposed policy matches the query, the model's actual support, and the values of the people affected.

Before deploying a policy, use the framework to write down the decision it governs. Specify the kinds of queries involved, the model signal available, the alternative response, and the cost assigned to each outcome. This turns “be safer” into a testable design question. It also helps separate a system that openly acknowledges uncertainty from one that simply becomes less useful by declining too broadly.

设计需要在某些时候不作答的系统时，可使用这篇论文。它提供了一份检查表：某项策略是否符合查询本身、模型真实能支持的内容，以及受影响人群的价值取向。

部署策略前，可用这个框架写清它实际管理的决定：涉及哪些查询，模型可用什么信号，另一种回应是什么，每种结果的代价如何计算。这样，“更安全”会变成可检验的设计问题，也能区分真正承认不确定性的系统与仅仅因拒绝范围过大而变得不够有用的系统。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Start with the three perspectives, then read the method, benchmark, and metric sections together. For any study, write down what the model is allowed to abstain from and what cost is assigned to an unnecessary refusal or an unsupported answer.

Add one more question while reading: what action follows from abstention? A system might ask for clarification, defer to a person, retrieve information, or simply stop; these options have different meanings. Compare reported results only when the alternative actions and the evaluation costs are aligned. The survey is most useful when it helps you expose these hidden choices rather than when it is used to select a single headline score.

建议先理解三个视角，再把方法、基准和指标部分连起来读。阅读任一研究时，记下模型可对什么拒答，以及不必要拒答和无依据回答分别付出什么代价。

阅读时还应加问一句：拒答之后系统会做什么？它可能请求澄清、交给人工、检索信息，或直接停止；这些选择含义不同。只有替代行动和评价代价相符时，才适合比较结果。这篇综述最大的价值，是帮助你暴露这些常被隐藏的选择，而不是挑选一个醒目的单一分数。
